title: Fix playerCollect fallback chain (always returns 'unknown')
description: P1 finding from 2026-07-11 audit (MSA-MF-006, council-verified as worse than reported): playerCollect handler uses entity?.metadata?.name but Mineflayer metadata is an array of MetadataPropertyValue objects, so .name on an array always returns undefined. Item names ALWAYS resolve to 'unknown'. Replace with version-safe fallback documented in AGENTS.md. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md (P1-005)
